'''February 2000 St. Cloud tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in The Time Vault, St. Cloud, MN on 26 February 2000. It is known from Peter Jacobson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d295">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-01-st-cloud-mn-2-26-00d295/ st-cloud-mn-2-26-00], DeckTech (Peter "jeeps" Jacobson, 1 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-01-st-cloud-mn-2-26-00d295/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 26 February 2000
* '''Site:''' The Time Vault, St. Cloud, MN
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 33
